exposure: women without male partners undergoing intrauterine insemination (IUI)
women with male partners undergoing intrauterine insemination (IUI)
cohort: The study included 2414 intrauterine insemination (IUI) cycles performed between 2017 and 2023, comparing 149 cycles for women without male partners (single and lesbian women) to 2265 cycles for women with male partners.
finding: Women without male partners undergoing IUI had similar rates of clinical pregnancy, miscarriage, live birth, obstetric complications, and neonatal outcomes compared to women with male partners undergoing IUI.
